causalDistinctness: Maximum prior-month daily return (MAX) continuation is a source-defined cross-sectional characteristic distinct from prior 7-day momentum, salience, basis, positioning, illiquidity, reversal, seasonality, breakout, CTREND and intraday lead-lag families. Same fixed research universe is reused only under hypothesis-fresh governance; no MAX price outcome has been opened before this lock.

externalEvidence.primary: Özdemir (2021), Financial Innovation 7:74, Lottery-like preferences and the MAX effect in the cryptocurrency market, DOI 10.1186/s40854-021-00291-9.
externalEvidence.sourceSignal: Maximum daily return within the previous month, recalculated weekly.
externalEvidence.sourceDirection: High MAX minus low MAX; the paper reports positive weekly high-minus-low performance and persistence after controls.
externalEvidence.sourcePortfolio: Decile sorts; both value-weighted and equal-weighted evidence reported.
externalEvidence.sourceSample: CoinMarketCap daily data, Jan 2014-Sep 2020; coins below $5m market cap excluded and new coins seasoned six months.
externalEvidence.adaptationDisclosure: MarketsGPT uses Binance USD-M perpetual daily bars, a fixed 120-name survivor-conditioned research universe, a six-month archive-age requirement, and prior-dollar-volume liquidity gating because point-in-time market cap is unavailable in the current free transport. This is a predeclared tradable adaptation, not an exact replication.

method.signal: MAX of fully completed UTC daily close-to-close returns over t-28 through t-1; no current-week information.
method.direction: LONG highest MAX decile; SHORT lowest MAX decile
method.crossSection: retain top 50 by prior 30 completed UTC days mean quoteAssetVolume, then rank MAX
method.holding: Monday open to next Monday open

universe.selection: same fixed 120 Binance Spot-USDT + USD-M perpetual research universe locked before MAX outcomes; reuse permitted only as a causally distinct hypothesis and remains survivor-conditioned.
universe.dynamicLiquidityFilter: prior 30 completed UTC days mean quoteAssetVolume >= 10,000,000 USDT
universe.liquiditySelection: retain top 50 by prior-30d mean quoteAssetVolume before MAX sorting
universe.seasoning: first available valid 1d archive bar must be at least 180 calendar days before rebalance
universe.survivorshipRule: Development pass alone cannot authorize production; untouched-period validation and a one-shot sealed holdout remain mandatory.

dataAuthority.source: Binance official data.binance.vision USD-M monthly 1d klines ZIP + CHECKSUM
dataAuthority.missingData: fail closed; no interpolation, no forward fill

costs.chargedOn: absolute weekly target-weight changes plus terminal liquidation
costs.note: Same conservative weekly cost schedule used in ARP26; not reduced after seeing other research outcomes.

statistics.multiplicityPolicy: Late-stage family: development requires P(mean>0)>=0.99, CI95 lower >0, both-half stability and materially positive stress returns before any validation may open.

failureRule: Any development failure closes ARP31-MAX1 with no sign, lookback, liquidity, top-N, weighting, holding, cost or gate rescue. Validation and holdout stay sealed unless the unchanged development specification passes every gate. R15 remains untouched until the full final release contract passes.
